questions.longer_section: Both clips contain the same run of sections. In which clip is the MIDDLE section longer? (A / B / no difference)
questions.higher_key: Which clip is in the higher key, i.e. sounds higher overall? (A / B / no difference)
questions.matches_lyrics: Which clip sings the words shown on screen in its middle section? (A / B / neither)
questions.plausibility_A: How musically plausible is clip A as a pop song excerpt? (1 = not at all ... 5 = completely)
questions.plausibility_B: How musically plausible is clip B? (1-5)
questions.edit_happened: Compared with the ORIGINAL, did the EDITED clip carry out the requested edit? (yes / partly / no)
questions.unrelated_consistent: Apart from the requested edit, did the rest of the music stay the same? (1 = completely different ... 5 = identical)
